t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Ke supa bopaki, O MOdimo wa me, gore ke Wena yo O ntlhodileng go Go itse le go Go direla. Ke paka, mo motsotsong o', bokowa ba me go matleng a Gago, khumanego ya me go khumong ya Gago. Ga gona ope o mongwe Modimo ga ese Wena, Mothusi mo Botlhokong. Motshidi ka Esi ba Gagwe.
